⏺ Fixed! v0.1.66 - Root Cause Found and Fixed                                                                                                                                                                                       
   
  I found the second bug that was causing the 45-degree tilt! It wasn't just the CFBLR pitch issue - the HAL LTDC driver was also messing up the window positions!                                                                  
                                                               
  The Problem                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  In stm32f7xx_hal_ltdc.c lines 2136-2139, the HAL adds AHBP (Accumulated Horizontal Back Porch = 35) to the window positions:

  // HAL adds AHBP to window positions!
  LTDC_LAYER(hltdc, LayerIdx)->WHPCR = ((pLayerCfg->WindowX0 + AHBP + 1) | (pLayerCfg->WindowX1 + AHBP) << 16);

  With WindowX0=0, WindowX1=800, AHBP=35:
  - Window START = 0 + 35 + 1 = 36 (should be 0!)
  - Window END = 800 + 35 = 835 (should be 800!)

  This means the LTDC was reading pixel data from the wrong framebuffer position - starting at byte 108 (pixel 36) instead of byte 0, combined with the CFBLR pitch error of 2403 instead of 2400.

  The Fix

  The fix temporarily sets BPCR AHBP to 0 before calling HAL_LTDC_ConfigLayer(), so it calculates window positions correctly:

  uint32_t bpcr_backup = hltdc_discovery.Instance->BPCR;  // Save original BPCR
  hltdc_discovery.Instance->BPCR &= ~(LTDC_BPCR_AHBP);    // Clear AHBP (set to 0)
  HAL_LTDC_ConfigLayer(&hltdc_discovery, &Layercfg, LayerIndex);
  hltdc_discovery.Instance->BPCR = bpcr_backup;  // Restore original BPCR

  Testing

  Please test the firmware:
  1. ATST150 - Checkerboard should show SQUARE cells with no diagonal tilt
  2. ATST1 - Text and graphics should be properly aligned

  The fix has been flashed to your device. Let me know if the display is now correct!

      2145  3. Created backup directories for each version                                                                                                                                                                          
      2146                                                                         
      2147  ---
      2148 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2149 +# Display Tilt Fix v0.1.66 - v0.1.67 (2026-02-16) - ROOT CAUSE FOUND!                                                                                                                                            
      2150 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2151 +## Problem Statement                                                                                                                                                                                             
      2152 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2153 +**45-degree diagonal tilt with 1-pixel-per-row offset** - Each subsequent row of pixels appears to be shifted by 1 pixel, creating a characteristic diagonal shear pattern across the entire display. The physica
           +l screen edges match the displayed image (total size is correct), but content within the active area is severely tilted.                                                                                         
      2154 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2155 +## Root Cause Discovery (v0.1.66)                                                                                                                                                                                
      2156 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2157 +The diagonal tilt was caused by **TWO separate bugs** in the HAL LTDC driver working together:                                                                                                                   
      2158 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2159 +### Bug 1: CFBLR Pitch Issue (Known from v0.1.64)                                                                                                                                                                
      2160 +**Location:** `stm32f7xx_hal_ltdc.c` lines 2189-2190                                                                                                                                                             
      2161 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2162 +```c                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      2163 +LTDC_LAYER(hltdc, LayerIdx)->CFBLR = (((pLayerCfg->ImageWidth * tmp) << 16U) | \                                                                                                                                 
      2164 +                                       (((pLayerCfg->WindowX1 - pLayerCfg->WindowX0) * tmp)  + 3U));                                                                                                             
      2165 +```                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      2166 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2167 +The HAL adds `+3` to the pitch for "alignment". For RGB888 with 800 pixel width:                                                                                                                                 
      2168 +- Expected: Pitch = 800 × 3 = 2400 bytes                                                                                                                                                                         
      2169 +- Actual: Pitch = 2400 + 3 = 2403 bytes                                                                                                                                                                          
      2170 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2171 +This causes each row to start 1 pixel (3 bytes) too late, creating cumulative diagonal shift.                                                                                                                    
      2172 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2173 +### Bug 2: Window Position Issue (NEWLY DISCOVERED!)                                                                                                                                                             
      2174 +**Location:** `stm32f7xx_hal_ltdc.c` lines 2136-2139                                                                                                                                                             
      2175 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2176 +```c                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      2177 +tmp = ((pLayerCfg->WindowX1 + ((hltdc->Instance->BPCR & LTDC_BPCR_AHBP) >> 16U)) << 16U);                                                                                                                        
      2178 +LTDC_LAYER(hltdc, LayerIdx)->WHPCR = ((pLayerCfg->WindowX0 + \                                                                                                                                                   
      2179 +                                       ((hltdc->Instance->BPCR & LTDC_BPCR_AHBP) >> 16U) + 1U) | tmp);                                                                                                           
      2180 +```                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      2181 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2182 +The HAL **adds AHBP (Accumulated Horizontal Back Porch) to window positions!**                                                                                                                                   
      2183 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2184 +With HSA=1, HBP=34: **AHBP = 35**                                                                                                                                                                                
      2185 +- WindowX0=0 → StartPos = 0 + 35 + 1 = **36** (should be 0!)                                                                                                                                                     
      2186 +- WindowX1=800 → StopPos = 800 + 35 = **835** (should be 800!)                                                                                                                                                   
      2187 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2188 +This causes the LTDC to read pixel data from the **wrong framebuffer position**, creating additional offset.                                                                                                     
      2189 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2190 +### Combined Effect                                                                                                                                                                                              
      2191 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2192 +With both bugs active:                                                                                                                                                                                           
      2193 +- Row 0: LTDC reads from framebuffer byte 108 (pixel 36) instead of byte 0                                                                                                                                       
      2194 +- Row 1: LTDC reads from framebuffer byte 2508 (2403 + 108) instead of byte 2400                                                                                                                                 
      2195 +- Each row, the offset increases by the pitch error (3 bytes = 1 pixel)                                                                                                                                          
      2196 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2197 +This creates the characteristic **45-degree diagonal tilt pattern**.                                                                                                                                             
      2198 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2199 +## Fix Applied (v0.1.66)                                                                                                                                                                                         
      2200 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2201 +**Location:** `Drivers/BSP/STM32F769I-Discovery/stm32f769i_discovery_lcd.c`                                                                                                                                      
      2202 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2203 +**Solution in `BSP_LCD_LayerDefaultInit()`:**                                                                                                                                                                    
      2204 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2205 +```c                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      2206 +/* CRITICAL FIX v0.1.66: Fix BOTH CFBLR pitch AND Window Position issues! */                                                                                                                                     
      2207 +uint32_t bpcr_backup = hltdc_discovery.Instance->BPCR;  // Save original BPCR                                                                                                                                    
      2208 +hltdc_discovery.Instance->BPCR &= ~(LTDC_BPCR_AHBP);    // Clear AHBP (set to 0)                                                                                                                                 
      2209 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2210 +HAL_LTDC_ConfigLayer(&hltdc_discovery, &Layercfg, LayerIndex);                                                                                                                                                   
      2211 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2212 +hltdc_discovery.Instance->BPCR = bpcr_backup;  // Restore original BPCR                                                                                                                                          
      2213 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2214 +/* Now fix CFBLR pitch for RGB888 format */                                                                                                                                                                      
      2215 +if (Layercfg.PixelFormat == LTDC_PIXEL_FORMAT_RGB888) {                                                                                                                                                          
      2216 +  uint32_t line_length = Layercfg.ImageWidth * 3;  /* 800 * 3 = 2400 */                                                                                                                                          
      2217 +  LTDC_LAYER(&hltdc_discovery, LayerIndex)->CFBLR = ((line_length << 16U) | line_length);                                                                                                                        
      2218 +  __HAL_LTDC_RELOAD_IMMEDIATE_CONFIG(&hltdc_discovery);                                                                                                                                                          
      2219 +}                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      2220 +```                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      2221 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2222 +By temporarily setting AHBP to 0 during `HAL_LTDC_ConfigLayer()`, the HAL calculates correct window positions. Then we restore BPCR and fix the CFBLR pitch.                                                     
      2223 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2224 +## Issue Found in v0.1.67 - Duplicate Conflicting Fixes                                                                                                                                                          
      2225 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2226 +**Problem:** The `main.c` file had duplicate fixes (lines 220-253) that were running **AFTER** the correct v0.1.66 fix in `BSP_LCD_LayerDefaultInit()`.                                                          
      2227 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2228 +### Issues in main.c (v0.1.66 and earlier)                                                                                                                                                                       
      2229 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2230 +**1. Incorrect Window Position Values:**                                                                                                                                                                         
      2231 +```c                                                                                                                                                                                                             
      2232 +LTDC_LAYER(&hltdc_discovery, 0)->WHPCR = (800 << 16U) | 0;  // WRONG!                                                                                                                                            
      2233 +LTDC_LAYER(&hltdc_discovery, 0)->WVPCR = (lcd_height << 16U) | 0;  // WRONG!                                                                                                                                     
      2234 +```                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      2235 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2236 +For LTDC layer window registers:                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2237 +- **StartPos** = first pixel to display (0-based)                                                                                                                                                                
      2238 +- **StopPos** = last pixel to display (0-based)                                                                                                                                                                  
      2239 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2240 +The code sets:                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      2241 +- WHPCR: StopPos=800, StartPos=0 → **Should be StopPos=799 for 800 pixels (0-799)!**                                                                                                                             
      2242 +- WVPCR: StopPos=height, StartPos=0 → **Should be StopPos=(height-1)!**                                                                                                                                          
      2243 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2244 +**2. Redundant CFBLR Fix:**                                                                                                                                                                                      
      2245 +Lines 233-253 attempted to fix CFBLR pitch again, but this was already handled correctly by `BSP_LCD_LayerDefaultInit()`.                                                                                        
      2246 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2247 +## Fix Applied (v0.1.67)                                                                                                                                                                                         
      2248 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2249 +**Removed duplicate fixes from main.c (lines 220-253)**                                                                                                                                                          
      2250 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2251 +The v0.1.66 fix in `BSP_LCD_LayerDefaultInit()` is now the **authoritative source of truth** for LTDC layer configuration.                                                                                       
      2252 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      2253 +**Enhanced diagnostic output:**                                                                                                                                                                                  
      2254 +```

      2257 +  WHPCR: 0x031F0001 (X0=0,X1=799) Expected=0x031F0001                                                                                                                                                            
      2258 +  WVPCR: 0x01D70001 (Y0=0,Y1=471)                                                                                                                                                                                
      2259 +```

      1141  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      1142  
      1143  /* =============================================================================                                                                                                                                        
      1144 + * Drawing Command Helper Functions                                                                                                                                                                              
      1145 + * ========================================================================== */                                                                                                                                 
      1146 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1147 +/**                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1148 + * @brief Convert hex color string to uint32_t                                                                                                                                                                   
      1149 + * @param hexStr Hex color string (e.g., "0xFF00" or "FF00" or "0xFF0000")                                                                                                                                       
      1150 + * @retval Color value as uint32_t                                                                                                                                                                               
      1151 + */                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1152 +uint32_t TEST_ParseHexColor(const char *hexStr) {                                                                                                                                                                
      1153 +  uint32_t color = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1154 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1155 +  // Skip "0x" prefix if present                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1156 +  if (hexStr[0] == '0' && (hexStr[1] == 'x' || hexStr[1] == 'X')) {                                                                                                                                              
      1157 +    hexStr += 2;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1158 +  }                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1159 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1160 +  // Parse hex string                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1161 +  while (*hexStr) {                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1162 +    char c = *hexStr++;                                                                                                                                                                                          
      1163 +    color <<= 4;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1164 +    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {                                                                                                                                                                                  
      1165 +      color |= (c - '0');                                                                                                                                                                                        
      1166 +    } else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') {                                                                                                                                                                           
      1167 +      color |= (c - 'A' + 10);                                                                                                                                                                                   
      1168 +    } else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') {                                                                                                                                                                           
      1169 +      color |= (c - 'a' + 10);                                                                                                                                                                                   
      1170 +    }                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1171 +  }                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1172 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1173 +  return color;                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      1174 +}                                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1175 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1176 +/**                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1177 + * @brief Parse drawing command parameters                                                                                                                                                                       
      1178 + * @param cmdParams Command parameters string (e.g., "100,200,5,0xFFFF")                                                                                                                                         
      1179 + * @param params Output parameter array                                                                                                                                                                          
      1180 + * @param paramCount Number of parameters to parse                                                                                                                                                               
      1181 + * @retval Number of parameters successfully parsed                                                                                                                                                              
      1182 + */                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1183 +int TEST_ParseDrawParams(const char *cmdParams, int32_t *params, int paramCount) {                                                                                                                               
      1184 +  int parsed = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1185 +  const char *p = cmdParams;                                                                                                                                                                                     
      1186 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1187 +  for (int i = 0; i < paramCount && *p != '\0'; i++) {                                                                                                                                                           
      1188 +    // Skip whitespace                                                                                                                                                                                           
      1189 +    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;                                                                                                                                                                         
      1190 +    if (*p == '\0') break;                                                                                                                                                                                       
      1191 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1192 +    // Check for hex color (starts with 0x or contains only hex digits for last param)                                                                                                                           
      1193 +    if (i == paramCount - 1 && (*p == '0' || strncmp(p, "0x", 2) == 0 || strncmp(p, "0X", 2) == 0)) {                                                                                                            
      1194 +      params[i] = (int32_t)TEST_ParseHexColor(p);                                                                                                                                                                
      1195 +      parsed++;                                                                                                                                                                                                  
      1196 +      break;                                                                                                                                                                                                     
      1197 +    }                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1198 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1199 +    // Parse decimal number                                                                                                                                                                                      
      1200 +    int32_t val = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                             
      1201 +    int negative = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1202 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1203 +    if (*p == '-') {                                                                                                                                                                                             
      1204 +      negative = 1;                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1205 +      p++;                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      1206 +    }                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1207 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1208 +    while (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') {                                                                                                                                                                             
      1209 +      val = val * 10 + (*p - '0');                                                                                                                                                                               
      1210 +      p++;                                                                                                                                                                                                       
      1211 +    }                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1212 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1213 +    if (negative) val = -val;                                                                                                                                                                                    
      1214 +    params[i] = val;                                                                                                                                                                                             
      1215 +    parsed++;                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      1216 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1217 +    // Skip comma                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1218 +    while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t') p++;                                                                                                                                                                         
      1219 +    if (*p == ',') p++;                                                                                                                                                                                          
      1220 +  }                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1221 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1222 +  return parsed;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1223 +}

      1234 +static TestStatus_TypeDef TEST_Draw_Point(int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t diameter, uint32_t color) {                                                                                                              
      1235 +  // Clamp coordinates to display bounds                                                                                                                                                                         
      1236 +  if (x < 0) x = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1237 +  if (x >= BSP_LCD_GetXSize()) x = BSP_LCD_GetXSize() - 1;                                                                                                                                                       
      1238 +  if (y < 0) y = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1239 +  if (y >= BSP_LCD_GetYSize()) y = BSP_LCD_GetYSize() - 1;

      1241 +  // Clamp diameter                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1242 +  if (diameter < 1) diameter = 1;                                                                                                                                                                                
      1243 +  if (diameter > 50) diameter = 50;                                                                                                                                                                              
      1244 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1245 +  // Draw point (filled circle)                                                                                                                                                                                  
      1246 +  BSP_LCD_SetTextColor(color);                                                                                                                                                                                   
      1247 +  BSP_LCD_FillCircle(x, y, diameter / 2);                                                                                                                                                                        
      1248 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1249 +  // Update current position                                                                                                                                                                                     
      1250 +  drawCurrentX = x;                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1251 +  drawCurrentY = y;                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1252 +  drawCurrentColor = color;

      1260 +/* =============================================================================                                                                                                                                 
      1261 + * ATST152 - Draw Line                                                                                                                                                                                           
      1262 + * ATST152=X,Y,D,C                                                                                                                                                                                               
      1263 + * Draws a line from current position to (X,Y)                                                                                                                                                                   
      1264 + * X: width coordinate (0-799 for MB1166)                                                                                                                                                                        
      1265 + * Y: height coordinate (0-471 for MB1166)                                                                                                                                                                       
      1266 + * D: point diameter at end position (1-50)                                                                                                                                                                      
      1267 + * C: line color (hex)                                                                                                                                                                                           
      1268 + * The end point becomes the new current position                                                                                                                                                                
      1269 + * ========================================================================== */                                                                                                                                 
      1270 +static TestStatus_TypeDef TEST_Draw_Line(int32_t x, int32_t y, int32_t diameter, uint32_t color) {                                                                                                               
      1271 +  if (!drawPositionSet) {                                                                                                                                                                                        
      1272 +    TEST_Output("\r\n[ATST152] ERROR: No current position. Use ATST151 first.\r\n");                                                                                                                             
      1273 +    return TEST_ERROR;                                                                                                                                                                                           
      1274 +  }                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1275 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1276 +  // Clamp coordinates to display bounds                                                                                                                                                                         
      1277 +  int32_t x1 = drawCurrentX;                                                                                                                                                                                     
      1278 +  int32_t y1 = drawCurrentY;                                                                                                                                                                                     
      1279 +  int32_t x2 = x;                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1280 +  int32_t y2 = y;                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1281 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1282 +  if (x2 < 0) x2 = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1283 +  if (x2 >= BSP_LCD_GetXSize()) x2 = BSP_LCD_GetXSize() - 1;                                                                                                                                                     
      1284 +  if (y2 < 0) y2 = 0;                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1285 +  if (y2 >= BSP_LCD_GetYSize()) y2 = BSP_LCD_GetYSize() - 1;                                                                                                                                                     
      1286 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1287 +  // Draw line                                                                                                                                                                                                   
      1288 +  BSP_LCD_SetTextColor(color);                                                                                                                                                                                   
      1289 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1290 +  // Use BSP_LCD_DrawLine if available, otherwise implement                                                                                                                                                      
      1291 +  // Draw line using simple algorithm                                                                                                                                                                            
      1292 +  int dx = abs(x2 - x1);                                                                                                                                                                                         
      1293 +  int dy = abs(y2 - y1);                                                                                                                                                                                         
      1294 +  int sx = (x1 < x2) ? 1 : -1;                                                                                                                                                                                   
      1295 +  int sy = (y1 < y2) ? 1 : -1;                                                                                                                                                                                   
      1296 +  int err = dx - dy;                                                                                                                                                                                             
      1297 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1298 +  int curX = x1;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1299 +  int curY = y1;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1300 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1301 +  while (1) {                                                                                                                                                                                                    
      1302 +    // Draw a small circle at each point for thicker lines                                                                                                                                                       
      1303 +    int lineWidth = (diameter > 0) ? (diameter / 2) : 1;                                                                                                                                                         
      1304 +    if (lineWidth < 1) lineWidth = 1;                                                                                                                                                                            
      1305 +    BSP_LCD_FillCircle(curX, curY, lineWidth);                                                                                                                                                                   
      1306 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1307 +    if (curX == x2 && curY == y2) break;                                                                                                                                                                         
      1308 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1309 +    int e2 = 2 * err;                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1310 +    if (e2 > -dy) {                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1311 +      err -= dy;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1312 +      curX += sx;                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1313 +    }                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1314 +    if (e2 < dx) {                                                                                                                                                                                               
      1315 +      err += dx;                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1316 +      curY += sy;                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1317 +    }                                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1318 +  }                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1319 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1320 +  // Draw end point                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1321 +  if (diameter > 1) {                                                                                                                                                                                            
      1322 +    BSP_LCD_FillCircle(x2, y2, diameter / 2);                                                                                                                                                                    
      1323 +  }                                                                                                                                                                                                              
      1324 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1325 +  // Update current position                                                                                                                                                                                     
      1326 +  drawCurrentX = x2;                                                                                                                                                                                             
      1327 +  drawCurrentY = y2;                                                                                                                                                                                             
      1328 +  drawCurrentColor = color;                                                                                                                                                                                      
      1329 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1330 +  TEST_Output("\r\n[ATST152] Line: (%ld,%ld)->(%ld,%ld) D=%ld Color=0x%08lx\r\n",                                                                                                                                
      1331 +              x1, y1, x2, y2, diameter, color);                                                                                                                                                                  
      1332 +                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
      1333 +  return TEST_OK;                                                                                                                                                                                                
      1334 +}

      1339 + * X: top-left X coordinate (0-799 for MB1166)

      1347 +                                        int32_t fill, uint32_t color) {

  v0.1.68 - Drawing Commands Addition                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                
  New Drawing Commands                                                                                                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  ┌─────────┬─────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ Command │ Parameters  │                               Description                                │
  ├─────────┼─────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ ATST151 │ X,Y,D,C     │ Draw point at (X,Y) with diameter D and color C. Sets current position.  │
  ├─────────┼─────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ ATST152 │ X,Y,D,C     │ Draw line from current position to (X,Y). Updates current position.      │
  ├─────────┼─────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ ATST154 │ X,Y,W,H,F,C │ Draw rectangle at (X,Y) with width W, height H. F=0 outline, F=1 filled. │
  ├─────────┼─────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ ATST159 │ (none)      │ Run drawing commands demonstration test.                                 │
  └─────────┴─────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Parameter Ranges

  - X: 0-799 (width coordinate)
  - Y: 0-471 (height coordinate)
  - D: 1-50 (diameter in pixels)
  - W: 1-800 (width in pixels)
  - H: 1-472 (height in pixels)
  - C: Hex color (e.g., 0xFF0000=red, 0x00FF00=green, 0x0000FF=blue, 0xFFFF=white)

  Example Usage

  ATST151=100,200,5,0xFF0000    - Red point at (100,200)
  ATST152=400,300,3,0x00FF00    - Green line to (400,300)
  ATST154=50,50,200,100,1,0xFF  - Filled blue rectangle
  ATST159                        - Drawing demo

  then I would like to use these commands in the future to create menus and plot graphs of the oscilloscope type. Here's a brief description of some:                                                                               
  АТSТ151=X,Y,D,C                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  Draw a point and the current position or start of a line                                                                                                                                                                      
  Where X is the width coordinate, Y is the screen height coordinate, D is the point diameter in pixels, C is the point/line color                                                                                              
  АТSТ152=X,Y,D,C                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  Draw a line from the current point to this point, and this point becomes the current position or start of the line                                                                                                            
  Where X is the width coordinate, Y is the screen height coordinate, D is the point diameter in pixels, C is the point/next line color                                                                                         
  АТSТ153=X,Y,W,H,F,C                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  Draw a circle/ellipse                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  Where X is the width coordinate of the center, Y is the screen height coordinate of the center, W is the width of the ellipse/circle, H is the height of the ellipse/circle, F is 0 (unfilled) / 1 (filled), C is the outline 
   color, and Fills                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  АТSТ154=X,Y,W,H,F,C                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  Draw a rectangle                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  Where X is the width coordinate, Y is the screen height coordinate, W is the width, H is the height, F is 0 (unfilled) / 1 (filled), C is the outline and fill color                                                          
  АТSТ155=X,Y,S,L,C,"TEXT"                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  Write text (text can be written in two languages: English/Russian) a point and the current position or the beginning of a line                                                                                                
  Where X is the width coordinate, Y is the screen height coordinate, S is the font size, L is the text writing angle (0 = 0, 1 = 90, 2 = 180, 3 = 270 degrees), C is the font color, TEXT - this text is drawn starting from   
  the X,Y coordinates and at an angle of L.                                                                                                                                                                                     
  ATST156 - ATST158 - create some commands, like a spline or something else for drawing graphs, for example.                                                                                                                    
  ATST159 is a simple test for testing these commands. Modify the ATST159 test by increasing the interval between elements for testing these commands by 4 times to make each primitive more visible.                           
  Add a module for reading sound from microphones and displaying them in a 400 pixel wide by 200 pixel window (4 microphones / 4 graphs, each 50 pixel high). The signal level from each microphone and an oscillogram are

      2037 +        sample += sin(t * freq * 0.5f) * 5000.0f;   // Add sub-harmonic

      2039 +      }                                                                                                                                                                                                          
      2040 +    }
